answer: Maturing bonds make every fake identity lock up capital for a week. A new key must deposit 100 POA into a vault where the bond ripens for 28 epochs before the key earns full rewards. If a juror sees a plume of near-identical answers rising from several keys in the same hour, it can freeze all of them until a 5-seat jury rules; a guilty verdict sends those bonds to the karst, a burn address no one controls. Honest keys get their bond back at maturity. A farm of 500 keys must tie up 50,000 POA and can lose it all on one flag.
